name: hero-bridge
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone square website hero artwork, 1024 by 1024 pixels or higher.
Primary request: a luxury editorial 3D illustration of a dramatic glowing violet suspension bridge emerging from an open antique book with gold-edged pages at the bottom of the image. An enormous perfectly circular amber sunset glows behind the bridge against a dark navy-black background.
Composition: realistic three-quarter perspective. The bridge first tower is large at center-left, with a farther tower smaller on the right, and the deck and suspension cables diminish convincingly into the distance. The open book spans the bottom foreground, its pages curve naturally and support the bridge world. Tiny bright stars run along the suspension cables. Keep the full book and bridge recognizably within frame.
Lighting: precise warm gold and electric violet lighting, luminous violet rails and towers, amber rim light, polished cinematic luxury editorial rendering, rich dark atmospheric shadows.
Materials: antique leather book binding, tactile ivory paper with gold page edges, metallic bridge details.
Constraints: only the illustrative artwork. No text or legible lettering anywhere, no webpage chrome, no border, no watermark.

name: classroom
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide landscape standalone editorial photograph for an English language school website, 1536 by 1024 pixels or wider landscape.
Primary request: four fictional adult learners, men and women, engaged in a thoughtful friendly group discussion around a table in a modern English language classroom. Show exactly four adults, with natural varied expressions, candid attentive poses and believable hands. Laptops and open notebooks sit on the table.
Scene: a polished contemporary learning room with purple and magenta accent lighting and a warm golden desk lamp illuminating the tabletop. The setting feels inviting, focused, premium and authentic.
Composition: medium-wide eye-level photograph showing all four learners and their group interaction around the table, with enough room context to establish the classroom.
Lighting and style: premium editorial photography, natural skin texture and realistic proportions, warm golden practical light balanced against subtle purple room accents, gentle depth of field.
Constraints: people are entirely fictional. No signage, no visible text or legible screen contents, no names, no logos, no watermark, no webpage elements.

name: faculty-contact-sheet
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square 2 by 2 contact sheet of four independent professional teacher portraits, 2048 by 2048 pixels if possible.
Primary request: four evenly sized fictional adult faculty headshots arranged in four precisely equal square quadrants. No gutters and no borders, no text or names. Each quadrant contains exactly one different adult teacher in a head-and-shoulders portrait against its own dark navy studio background, with consistent warm studio lighting and premium professional photography.
Upper-left quadrant: smiling Middle Eastern woman with dark hair and a black jacket.
Upper-right quadrant: Middle Eastern man with short dark hair, glasses, and a navy jacket.
Lower-left quadrant: East Asian woman with glasses and a gray jacket.
Lower-right quadrant: light-skinned man with short brown hair, glasses, and a charcoal jacket.
Framing: keep each complete head fully inside its own quadrant, with comfortable empty margins above and at the sides of each head, face centered horizontally within its quadrant, upper torso and shoulders visible. Every portrait must be independently usable as a CSS quadrant crop. Exact grid boundaries at the horizontal and vertical midpoint.
Constraints: entirely fictional adults; photorealistic studio headshots; no text, labels, names, logos, watermark or webpage chrome; no overlap between quadrants; no cropping through a head.
